cards.card_text: Jesus hears that news, and He replies, "Go tell that fox…"
cards.verse_text: But Jesus replied, “Go tell that fox, ‘Look, I will keep driving out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will reach My goal.’

cards.card_text: Jesus sends a message to "that fox." What does He say He'll keep doing today and tomorrow?
